CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_org_summary(_target uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE d jsonb; BEGIN d:=private.slot_account_previous_summary(_target); RETURN jsonb_set(d,'{roles}',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name)),'[]') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r.id,r.name FROM private.role_source_rows(private.base_config()) s JOIN app_roles r ON r.id=s.role_id WHERE s.user_id=_target AND cardinality(s.permissions)>0) x)); END $function$
functions.name: account_org_summary

functions.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.role_catalog_read()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE d jsonb; counts jsonb; BEGIN d:=private.slot_catalog_previous_read(); SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(role_id,stats),'{}') INTO counts FROM (SELECT role_id,jsonb_build_object('total',count(DISTINCT user_id),'slots',count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER(WHERE source_kind='slot'),'tasks',count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER(WHERE source_kind IN ('task','specialty')),'direct',count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER(WHERE source_kind='direct'),'legacy',count(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER(WHERE source_kind='title_legacy')) stats FROM private.role_source_rows(private.base_config()) GROUP BY role_id) x; RETURN jsonb_set(d,'{roles}',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r||jsonb_build_object('receivers',coalesce((counts->(r->>'id')->>'total')::int,0),'receiver_counts',coalesce(counts->(r->>'id'),'{}'))),'[]') FROM jsonb_array_elements(d->'roles') r)); END $function$
functions.name: role_catalog_read

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_source_rows(c jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, role_id text, source_kind text, source_id text, unit_id text, legacy boolean, eligible boolean, scope text, permissions text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT * FROM private.slot_previous_source_rows(c)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT (m->>'user_id')::uuid,r.id,'task',m->>'id'||':'||s.id,m->>'unit_id',true,private.org_marketing_eligible((m->>'user_id')::uuid,c),'native',ARRAY(SELECT p FROM unnest(r.permissions) p WHERE private.org_role_permission_ready(p))
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'memberships','[]')) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(m->'specialty_ids','[]')) sid JOIN mkt_specialties s ON s.id=sid AND s.active JOIN app_roles r ON r.id=s.role_id
 WHERE private.is_active((m->>'user_id')::uuid) AND private.base_valid_at(m) AND m->>'status'='active' AND m->'specialty_signatures'->>s.id=md5(coalesce(r.permissions,'{}')::text) $function$
functions.name: role_source_rows

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.permission_editor_policy()
 RETURNS TABLE(key text, scope text, personal boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT v.key,v.scope,v.personal FROM (VALUES ('k3.use','own',true),('leave.create','own',true),('leave.view_own','own',true),('leave.edit_own','own',true),('leave.recall','own',true),('att.create','own',true),('att.view_own','own',true),('att.edit_own','own',true),('att.witness','own',true),('order.view','own',true),('order.view_mine','own',true),('order.take','own',true),('order.update_draft','own',true),('order.submit','own',true),('order.history','own',true),('web.view','assigned',false),('web.content_view','assigned',false),('web.content_view_mine','assigned',false),('web.outline_start','assigned',false),('web.outline_submit','assigned',false),('web.post_write_start','assigned',false),('web.post_submit','assigned',false),('web.keyword_view','assigned',false),('web.keyword_open_sheet','assigned',false),('local.view','assigned',false),('local.view_mine','assigned',false),('local.post_create','assigned',false),('local.post_edit','assigned',false),('social.view','assigned',false),('social.post_view','assigned',false),('social.post_view_mine','assigned',false),('social.post_create','assigned',false),('social.post_edit','assigned',false),('social.post_start','assigned',false),('social.post_submit','assigned',false),('video.view','assigned',false),('video.view_mine','assigned',false),('video.create','assigned',false),('video.script_start','assigned',false),('video.script_submit','assigned',false),('video.submit','assigned',false),('leave.view_unit','unit',false),('ot.view_unit','unit',false)) v(key,scope,personal) JOIN base_permission_catalog b ON b.key=v.key WHERE private.org_role_permission_ready(v.key) OR private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(v.key) $function$
functions.name: permission_editor_policy

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.permission_editor_read()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN IF NOT private.is_active(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cần đăng nhập bằng tài khoản hoạt động.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; RETURN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)||jsonb_build_object('position_ready',private.org_role_permission_ready(p.key),'task_ready',private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(p.key) AND p.scope<>'unit')),'[]') FROM private.permission_editor_policy() p); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_editor_validate(kind text, next_permissions text[], previous_permissions text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(coalesce(next_permissions,'{}')) p WHERE NOT p=ANY(coalesce(previous_permissions,'{}')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.permission_editor_policy() s WHERE s.key=p AND CASE WHEN kind='marketing_task' THEN private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(p) AND s.scope<>'unit' ELSE private.org_role_permission_ready(p) END)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quyền mới chưa có phạm vi an toàn; giữ cấu hình hiện tại hoặc chọn quyền đã kiểm chứng.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; END $function$
functions.name: role_editor_validate

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.base_rules(u uuid, c jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(r),'[]') FROM jsonb_array_elements(private.reset_previous_base_rules(u,c)) r WHERE NOT private.legacy_reset_applies(u) OR r->>'effect'='DENY' OR (r->>'source_kind' IN ('appointment_role','marketing_appointment') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_roles ar WHERE ar.id=r->>'role_id' AND ar.catalog_state='standard'))
$function$
functions.name: base_rules

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_permission(_user_id uuid, _permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT private.is_active(_user_id) AND (private.is_super_admin(_user_id) OR CASE
 WHEN (private.org_role_permission_ready(_permission) OR private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(_permission) OR _permission LIKE 'sale_work.%') AND private.base_tier1(_user_id,_permission)='DENY' THEN false
 WHEN (private.org_role_permission_ready(_permission) OR private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(_permission) OR _permission LIKE 'sale_work.%') AND private.base_tier1(_user_id,_permission)='ALLOW' THEN true
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND o.mode='replace') THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND _permission=ANY(o.permissions))
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN app_roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=_user_id AND _permission=ANY(r.permissions))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND o.mode='additive' AND _permission=ANY(o.permissions)) END) $function$
functions.name: has_permission
